Author: TimeTaEat
Text: $NFLX Bulls, don't overlook the short-interest setup. The last official snapshot showed 94.2M shares short, or 2.3% of the float, as of 9/15. That's not today's number, and that's the point. We’ve had another two weeks of price action since that snapshot, yet we won’t know what shorts actually did during the decline until the 9/30 report comes out 10/9. If short interest increased into this weakness, there could be significantly more fuel behind a reversal than the current 2.3% figure suggests. If NFLX reclaims key resistance and momentum flips, shorts don't get to remain comfortable forever. Price reversal + trapped shorts + fresh buyers can turn a bleeding chart into a very different setup quickly. I'm not calling a squeeze. I'm saying the current short-interest number is a snapshot, not the whole story.
